For Students

Frequently Asked Questions

A few answers to help you find your way around SVS

For Students

FAQsAdmissionsDownloadsTimetables & resultsStudent supportHoliday List
Where can I find the current fees and seat details?

Ask the relevant college for its current fee notice and sanctioned intake. Check the applicable academic-year approval records before applying.

College contacts →
Are undergraduate and postgraduate courses available?

Explore MBBS and MD/MS in Medicine, BDS and MDS in Dentistry, and undergraduate and postgraduate Nursing programmes. Each course page explains the available options.

Browse courses →
Can I arrange hostel accommodation?

The colleges have hostel facilities. Contact your college for availability, fees and the arrangements applicable to your programme.

Hostel information →
How do I find the college?

The medical and nursing colleges are in Yenugonda, Mahabubnagar. The dental campus is at Appanapally. Use the college-specific directions on Contact Us.

Addresses & directions →
Whom should I ask if I am unsure?

Choose your college on the Contact Us form or call its office. Tell the team which programme you are interested in so they can direct your enquiry.

Ask a question →
Where can I download forms and academic documents?

The Downloads page brings together the available admission documents, student development records, holiday lists and links to academic schedules.

Open Downloads →
Who can help with a student concern?

Start with your faculty mentor or college office. The Student Support page explains the available support routes; committee responsibilities are listed separately.

Student support →
How do I contact the teaching hospital?

Call 08542-227799 for appointments, OPD timings and service availability. For urgent care, go directly to the Emergency/Casualty department.

Hospital visitor information →
How do I send an enquiry or complaint?

At the bottom of Contact Us, choose Enquiry or Complain to us, select your college and enter your message. Mail us prepares an email in your email application for you to review and send.

Write to your college →
Where are the holiday lists?

Open Holiday List and choose the list for your college, programme and year. For a schedule not listed there, contact your college office.

Holiday List →
